title: Fold models into team once, at config load
action:
Add ONE helper in `packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/verbs/drivers/models.rs`:

```rust
/// team-config-rename D2: the roster block is `team`; `models` is a read alias.
/// Returns true when the legacy key served (folded or dropped), false otherwise.
pub(crate) fn fold_team_key(map: &mut Map<String, Value>) -> bool
```

Semantics, exactly: `team` absent + `models` present → move `models` to `team`, return true. Both present → remove `models` (team wins), return true. `team` present but NOT an object → do nothing, return false (leave every site's existing handling alone — no new refusal). Neither → false.

Call it from the three config loaders, right beside their existing `shift_remove("advisor")` normalization: `state.rs:161 read_config_raw` (the shift_remove is at :185), `hooks/session_preamble/state.rs:50 read_config_raw_open` (:61), `hooks/compaction.rs:124 read_config_failopen`. Also call it in `onboard/agents.rs:73` `agent_models`, which reads the file directly via `read_json_if_exists` and bypasses all three loaders.

Then change every production reader of the loaded map from `"models"` to `"team"`: `doctor.rs:297`, `verbs/models_group.rs:149`, `verbs/status_full/build.rs:343`, `store.rs:448`, `store.rs:535`, `store.rs:853`, `hooks/model_guard.rs:80`, `herding/wave.rs:358`, and the `dispatch_door_lines` callers. For `dispatch_door_lines` (`hooks/model_guard.rs:520`): change its signature to take the whole loaded map (or root) and read `"team"` itself, so `session_preamble/budget.rs:650` and `compaction.rs:1525` stop reading the key at all — one reader, not three. `read_models` (`models.rs:286`) reads `"team"` too.

DO NOT touch: `hooks/session_close/perf.rs:576` (a session usage record, not config); `verbs/status_full/build.rs:339-344` (the PUBLIC `bee status --json` output key named `models` — it stays, and so do its tests at `status_full/tests.rs`). The three `model_guard.rs` test fixtures (:2015, :2549, :2582) become `team`-keyed.

Tests, in `models.rs`'s test module: the four fold cases plus the non-object case. And the guard's existing role tests must pass against `team`-keyed fixtures.

The regression gate this cell must leave EMPTY:
```
rg -n 'get\("models"\)' packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src --glob '*.rs' | grep -v 'hooks/session_close/perf.rs' | grep -v 'verbs/status_full/build.rs:3[34][0-9]' | grep -v '/tests\|tests.rs\|#\[cfg(test)\]'
```
verify: PATH="${CARGO_HOME:-$HOME/.cargo}/bin:$PATH" cargo test --release --no-fail-fast --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml --bin bee -- drivers::models model_guard status_full && ! rg -n 'get\("models"\)' packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src --glob '*.rs' | grep -v 'hooks/session_close/perf.rs' | grep -v 'verbs/status_full/build.rs:3[34][0-9]' | grep -v '/tests\|tests.rs\|#\[cfg(test)\]' | grep -q .
